<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Tunaikan Zakat & Kebaikan - LAZ Wanita Islam</title>
  
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
  
  <style>
    :root {
      --lilac-primary: #54366F;
      --lilac-dark: #3D2452;
      --lilac-light: #F5F0FA;
      --lilac-soft: #D9C9E8;
      --gold-accent: #C5A46D;
      --gold-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #E6D2AD 0%, #C5A46D 50%, #9E7D47 100%);
      --text-dark: #22222B;
      --text-muted: #666675;
      --bg-gray: #F8F9FA;
      --white: #FFFFFF;
      --border-color: #E6E4EA;
      --font-heading: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      --font-body: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    body { font-family: var(--font-body); background-color: #181820; color: var(--text-dark); padding: 20px; }

    /* TOOLBAR */
    .preview-header {
      max-width: 1240px; margin: 0 auto 20px auto; background: #242430; padding: 14px 24px;
      border-radius: 14px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; color: white;
    }
    .preview-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
    .preview-title span { background: var(--lilac-primary); color: white; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 11px; }

    .nav-page-tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
    .page-tab-btn {
      background: #1A1A24; border: 1px solid #3E3E54; color: #CCC; padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    }
    .page-tab-btn.active { background: var(--lilac-primary); border-color: var(--gold-accent); color: white; }

    .view-switcher { display: flex; background: #14141C; padding: 4px; border-radius: 8px; gap: 4px; }
    .btn-switch {
      background: transparent; border: none; color: #9A9AA6; padding: 6px 14px; font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    }
    .btn-switch.active { background: var(--lilac-primary); color: white; }

    /* VIEWPORT */
    .viewport-wrapper { display: flex; justify-content: center; padding-bottom: 60px; }
    .device-container { background: white; transition: all 0.3s ease; position: relative; box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); }
    .device-container.desktop-view { width: 100%; max-width: 1200px; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; }
    .device-container.mobile-view { width: 390px; min-height: 844px; border-radius: 40px; border: 12px solid #2B2B36; overflow: hidden; margin: 20px 0; }
    
    .mobile-notch { display: none; width: 140px; height: 24px; background: #2B2B36; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); border-bottom-left-radius: 14px; border-bottom-right-radius: 14px; z-index: 1000; }
    .device-container.mobile-view .mobile-notch { display: block; }

    /* STYLES */
    .topbar {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3E1E52 0%, #54366F 50%, #46225B 100%);
      color: white; padding: 9px 30px; font-size: 12px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
    }
    .topbar a { color: #E2D5EC; text-decoration: none; margin-left: 15px; }

    .navbar {
      display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 16px 30px; background: white;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 100;
    }
    .brand-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
    .logo-badge {
      width: 46px; height: 46px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--lilac-primary), var(--lilac-dark));
      border: 2px solid var(--gold-accent); border-radius: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      color: white; font-weight: 800; font-size: 19px; font-family: var(--font-heading);
    }
    .brand-text h1 { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--lilac-dark); line-height: 1.1; font-family: var(--font-heading); }
    .brand-text span { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); }
    .nav-links { display: flex; list-style: none; gap: 24px; align-items: center; }
    .nav-links a { text-decoration: none; color: var(--text-dark); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }
    .nav-links a.active { color: var(--lilac-primary); font-weight: 700; }
    
    .btn-donasi-header {
      background: var(--gold-gradient); color: #362203 !important; padding: 10px 22px; border-radius: 20px;
      font-size: 13px !important; font-weight: 800 !important; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(197, 154, 63, 0.45);
      border: 1px solid #C5A46D !important;
    }

    /* HERO */
    .page-hero {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4A2761 0%, #54366F 100%);
      color: white; padding: 50px 30px; text-align: center;
    }
    .page-hero h2 { font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 36px; margin-bottom: 10px; font-weight: 700; }
    .page-hero h2 span { color: #F5D77F; }
    .page-hero p { font-size: 15px; color: #EBDCF5; max-width: 700px; margin: 0 auto; line-height: 1.6; }

    /* DONATION PAGE LAYOUT */
    .donation-page-container {
      padding: 50px 30px; max-width: 1040px; margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .donation-grid-main {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.25fr 0.75fr; gap: 36px; align-items: flex-start;
    }

    .bank-group-title {
      font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 18px; color: var(--lilac-dark); margin-bottom: 14px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    }

    .bank-card {
      background: white; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px 20px;
      margin-bottom: 16px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.02); transition: border-color 0.2s;
    }
    .bank-card:hover { border-color: var(--lilac-primary); }

    .bank-info h5 { font-size: 15px; color: var(--lilac-dark); margin-bottom: 4px; font-weight: 700; }
    .acc-number { font-family: monospace; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-dark); }
    .acc-name { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 2px; }

    .btn-copy {
      background: var(--bg-gray); border: 1px solid #CCC; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 6px;
      font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .btn-copy:hover { background: var(--lilac-soft); border-color: var(--lilac-primary); color: var(--lilac-dark); }

    /* QRIS CARD */
    .qris-card-wrap {
      background: #FDFAFF; border: 2px solid var(--lilac-soft); border-radius: 16px; padding: 26px 20px;
      text-align: center; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
    }
    .qris-badge {
      background: var(--gold-gradient); color: #362203; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; padding: 4px 12px;
      border-radius: 20px; margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .qris-box-large {
      width: 220px; height: 220px; background: white; border: 2px dashed #B8A1C9; border-radius: 12px;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin: 10px 0 16px 0;
      color: var(--lilac-dark); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
    }
    .qris-note { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.5; }

    /* WA CONFIRMATION BOX */
    .wa-confirm-card {
      background: #EAF8F0; border: 1px solid #BFEBD3; border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px; margin-top: 26px;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px;
    }
    .wa-confirm-card h4 { font-size: 14px; color: #1E6641; font-weight: 700; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .wa-confirm-card p { font-size: 12px; color: #377051; line-height: 1.5; }
    .btn-wa-confirm-large {
      background: #25D366; color: white; text-decoration: none; padding: 12px; border-radius: 8px;
      font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; text-align: center; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(37, 211, 102, 0.3);
    }

    /* KALKULATOR ZAKAT INTERAKTIF (ALA DOMPET DHUAFA) */
    .zakat-calc-card {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FAF6FD 0%, #FFFFFF 100%);
      border: 2px solid var(--lilac-soft);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 28px 30px;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(123, 82, 148, 0.06);
    }

    .calc-header-title {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: 20px;
      color: var(--lilac-dark);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .calc-header-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .calc-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      padding-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .calc-tab-btn {
      background: white;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    .calc-tab-btn.active {
      background: var(--lilac-primary);
      border-color: var(--lilac-primary);
      color: white;
    }

    .calc-body-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 0.8fr;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .calc-input-group {
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .calc-label {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      display: block;
    }

    .calc-input-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .calc-input-prefix {
      position: absolute;
      left: 12px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .calc-input {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 10px 14px 10px 42px;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border-color);
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color 0.2s;
    }

    .calc-input:focus {
      border-color: var(--lilac-primary);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(123, 82, 148, 0.15);
    }

    .calc-result-box {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F8F3FA 0%, #F1E5F7 100%);
      border: 1.5px solid #D9C3E6;
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 22px;
      text-align: center;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .result-badge {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--lilac-dark);
      background: rgba(123, 82, 148, 0.12);
      padding: 3px 10px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .result-nominal {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: 26px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--lilac-dark);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .result-note {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .btn-calc-donasi {
      background: var(--gold-gradient);
      color: #362203;
      text-decoration: none;
      padding: 9px 18px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 800;
      border: 1px solid #C5A46D;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(197, 154, 63, 0.35);
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    /* PANDUAN RINGKAS */
    .guide-box {
      background: white; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 14px; padding: 24px;
      margin-top: 36px;
    }
    .guide-box h4 { font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 18px; color: var(--lilac-dark); margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .guide-box ol { padding-left: 20px; font-size: 13px; color: #555566; line-height: 1.8; }

    /* FOOTER */
    .site-footer {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3B1B4F 0%, #4F2D64 60%, #351747 100%);
      color: white; padding: 45px 30px 24px 30px; font-size: 13px; border-top: 3px solid #C5A46D;
    }
    .footer-content { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px; }
    .footer-brand h4 { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 10px; color: var(--gold-accent); font-family: var(--font-heading); }
    .footer-brand p { color: #DDD4E4; line-height: 1.6; }
    .footer-col h5 { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 12px; color: white; font-family: var(--font-heading); }
    .footer-col ul { list-style: none; }
    .footer-col li { margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .footer-col a { color: #DDD4E4; text-decoration: none; }
    .footer-bottom { border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); padding-top: 16px; text-align: center; color: #BBA9CA; font-size: 12px; }

    /* STICKY BOTTOM BAR & BACK-TO-TOP (PERSIS BENCHMARK DOMPET DHUAFA) */
    .mobile-bottom-bar {
      display: none;
      position: sticky;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: #FFFFFF;
      box-shadow: 0 -4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
      padding: 6px 16px 10px 16px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
      z-index: 999;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      overflow: visible;
    }

        /* TOMBOL SCROLL TO TOP ALA DOMPET DHUAFA (SEJAJAR CENTER DI ATAS TAB BERANDA) */
    .mobile-back-to-top {
      position: absolute;
      top: -39px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 44px;
      height: 32px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #6A448C 0%, var(--lilac-primary) 100%);
      border-top-left-radius: 12px;
      border-top-right-radius: 12px;
      border-bottom-left-radius: 0;
      border-bottom-right-radius: 0;
      border: 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
      border-bottom: none;
      color: #FFFFFF;
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 15px;
      cursor: pointer;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
      box-shadow: 0 -4px 12px rgba(84, 54, 111, 0.25);
      z-index: 998;
    }
    .mobile-back-to-top:hover,
    .mobile-back-to-top:active {
      opacity: 1 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-2px);
    }

    .btn-mobile-nav-tab {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      text-decoration: none;
      color: #4A4A58;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      gap: 3px;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      min-width: 60px;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }
    .btn-mobile-nav-tab i {
      font-size: 21px;
      color: var(--lilac-primary);
      transition: transform 0.2s ease;
    }
    .btn-mobile-nav-tab.tab-layanan i {
      color: #16A34A;
    }
    .btn-mobile-nav-tab:active i {
      transform: scale(1.15);
    }

    /* TOMBOL TUNAIKAN TENGAH (FLOATING ELEVATED) */
    .btn-mobile-donasi-center {
      height: 48px;
      padding: 0 24px;
      margin-top: -18px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ECC874 0%, #C59A3F 50%, #9E7422 100%);
      color: #2A1700 !important;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 14.5px;
      letter-spacing: 0.2px;
      border-radius: 25px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      text-decoration: none;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(197, 154, 63, 0.48), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
      border: 2.5px solid #FFFFFF;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
    }
    .btn-mobile-donasi-center:hover {
      box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(197, 154, 63, 0.58);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }
    .btn-mobile-donasi-center:active {
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    /* MOBILE TWEAKS */
    .device-container.mobile-view .topbar { display: none; }
    .device-container.mobile-view .nav-links, .device-container.mobile-view .btn-donasi-header { display: none; }
    .device-container.mobile-view .navbar { padding: 12px 18px; padding-top: 28px; }
    .device-container.mobile-view .calc-body-grid {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .mobile-right-actions {
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .mobile-btn-donasi-header {
      background: var(--gold-gradient);
      color: #362203 !important;
      padding: 7px 14px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      font-size: 12px !important;
      font-weight: 800 !important;
      text-decoration: none;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      border: 1px solid #C5A46D;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(197, 164, 109, 0.35);
    }
    .hamburger-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      padding: 7px 11px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--lilac-primary);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .mobile-drawer-menu {
      display: none;
      background: #FFFFFF;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      padding: 16px 20px;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    }
    .mobile-drawer-menu.active {
      display: block;
      animation: slideDown 0.3s ease;
    }
    .mobile-drawer-links {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .mobile-drawer-links a {
      text-decoration: none;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 8px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #F3F4F6;
    }
    .mobile-drawer-links a:hover { color: var(--lilac-primary); }

    .device-container.mobile-view .calc-tabs {
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .device-container.mobile-view .nav-links,
    .device-container.mobile-view .btn-donasi-header {
      display: none !important;
    }
    .device-container.mobile-view .mobile-right-actions {
      display: flex !important;
    }
    .device-container.mobile-view .navbar {
      padding: 10px 16px !important;
      justify-content: space-between !important;
      flex-direction: row !important;
    }

    .device-container.mobile-view .donation-grid-main { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 24px; }
    .device-container.mobile-view .footer-content { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 20px; }
    .device-container.mobile-view .mobile-bottom-bar { display: flex; }

    /* MEDIA QUERY RESPONSIVE REAL DEVICE (SMARTPHONE) */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      body {
        padding: 0 !important;
      }
      .preview-header {
        display: none !important;
      }
      .viewport-wrapper {
        padding: 0 !important;
      }
      .device-container {
        border-radius: 0 !important;
        border: none !important;
        box-shadow: none !important;
        max-width: 100% !important;
        width: 100% !important;
      }
      .topbar {
        display: none !important;
      }
      .navbar {
        padding: 10px 16px !important;
        justify-content: space-between !important;
        flex-direction: row !important;
        position: sticky !important;
        top: 0 !important;
        z-index: 1000 !important;
      }
      .nav-links,
      .btn-donasi-header {
        display: none !important;
      }
      .mobile-right-actions {
        display: flex !important;
      }
      .page-hero {
        padding: 30px 16px !important;
      }
      .page-hero h2 {
        font-size: 26px !important;
      }
      .donation-page-container {
        padding: 24px 16px !important;
      }
      .calc-body-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
        gap: 20px !important;
      }
      .calc-tabs {
        flex-direction: column !important;
        gap: 6px !important;
      }
      .donation-grid-main {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
        gap: 24px !important;
      }
      .footer-content {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
        gap: 20px !important;
      }
      .mobile-bottom-bar {
        display: flex !important;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <!-- TOOLBAR -->
  <div class="preview-header">
    <div class="preview-title">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-qrcode" style="color: var(--gold-accent);"></i>
      <span>HALAMAN 4</span> Rekening Bank Resmi & QRIS
    </div>
    
    <div class="nav-page-tabs">
      <a href="index.html" class="page-tab-btn"><i class="fa-solid fa-home"></i> Beranda</a>

  <script>
    let currentCalcType = 'penghasilan';
    const NISAB_BULANAN = 6800000; // Nisab bulanan setara 85gr emas / 12 bln
    const NISAB_TAHUNAN = 81600000; // Nisab tahunan setara 85gr emas

    // Fungsi format rupiah dengan titik pemisah ribuan otomatis
    function formatNumberRupiah(numStr) {
      const cleanNum = numStr.replace(/\D/g, '');
      if (!cleanNum) return '';
      return parseInt(cleanNum, 10).toLocaleString('id-ID');
    }

    function parseRupiah(valStr) {
      if (!valStr) return 0;
      const cleanNum = valStr.replace(/\D/g, '');
      return parseInt(cleanNum, 10) || 0;
    }

    function handleRupiahInput(inputElem) {
      const rawVal = inputElem.value;
      inputElem.value = formatNumberRupiah(rawVal);
      calculateZakat();
    }

    function switchCalc(type) {
      currentCalcType = type;
      const tabPenghasilan = document.getElementById('tabPenghasilan');
      const tabMaal = document.getElementById('tabMaal');
      const labelPendapatan = document.getElementById('labelPendapatan');
      const labelPengeluaran = document.getElementById('labelPengeluaran');

      // Kosongkan input agar bersih saat ganti tab
      document.getElementById('inputPenghasilan').value = '';
      document.getElementById('inputTambahan').value = '';
      document.getElementById('inputPengeluaran').value = '';

      if (type === 'penghasilan') {
        tabPenghasilan.classList.add('active');
        tabMaal.classList.remove('active');
        labelPendapatan.innerText = 'Penghasilan / Gaji per Bulan';
        labelPengeluaran.innerText = 'Kebutuhan Pokok / Utang Jatuh Tempo (per Bulan)';
      } else {
        tabMaal.classList.add('active');
        tabPenghasilan.classList.remove('active');
        labelPendapatan.innerText = 'Total Tabungan, Emas, Deposito, & Aset Likuid';
        labelPengeluaran.innerText = 'Hutang / Kewajiban Jatuh Tempo Tahun Ini';
      }
      calculateZakat();
    }

    function calculateZakat() {
      const p1 = parseRupiah(document.getElementById('inputPenghasilan').value);
      const p2 = parseRupiah(document.getElementById('inputTambahan').value);
      const out = parseRupiah(document.getElementById('inputPengeluaran').value);

      const totalHarta = p1 + p2;
      const bersih = totalHarta - out;
      let zakat = 0;
      const displayNominal = document.getElementById('displayZakatNominal');
      const displayNote = document.getElementById('displayNisabNote');

      const nisab = currentCalcType === 'penghasilan' ? NISAB_BULANAN : NISAB_TAHUNAN;

      if (totalHarta === 0) {
        displayNominal.innerText = 'Rp 0';
        displayNote.innerHTML = 'Ketik nominal angka di atas untuk mulai menghitung.';
        return;
      }

      if (bersih >= nisab) {
        zakat = bersih * 0.025;
        displayNominal.innerText = 'Rp ' + Math.round(zakat).toLocaleString('id-ID');
        displayNote.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#10B981; font-weight:700;"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check"></i> Wajib Zakat</span> (Penghasilan bersih di atas nisab Rp ' + nisab.toLocaleString('id-ID') + ')';
      } else {
        displayNominal.innerText = 'Rp 0';
        displayNote.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#F59E0B; font-weight:700;"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-info"></i> Belum Wajib Zakat</span> (Di bawah nisab Rp ' + nisab.toLocaleString('id-ID') + ', disarankan infak/sedekah)';
      }
    }

    function setMode(mode) {
      const frame = document.getElementById('deviceFrame');
      const btnDesktop = document.getElementById('btnDesktop');
      const btnMobile = document.getElementById('btnMobile');
      const drawer = document.getElementById('mobileNavDrawer');
      const icon = document.getElementById('mobileNavIcon');

      if (mode === 'mobile') {
        frame.className = 'device-container mobile-view';
        btnMobile.classList.add('active');
        btnDesktop.classList.remove('active');
      } else {
        frame.className = 'device-container desktop-view';
        btnDesktop.classList.add('active');
        btnMobile.classList.remove('active');
        if (drawer) drawer.style.display = 'none';
        if (icon) icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-bars';
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
      if (window.innerWidth > 768) {
        var drawer = document.getElementById('mobileNavDrawer');
        var icon = document.getElementById('mobileNavIcon');
        if (drawer) drawer.style.display = 'none';
        if (icon) icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-bars';
      }
    });

    function toggleMobileNav() {
      var drawer = document.getElementById('mobileNavDrawer');
      var icon = document.getElementById('mobileNavIcon');
      if (!drawer) return;
      if (drawer.style.display === 'block') {
        drawer.style.display = 'none';
        if (icon) icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-bars';
      } else {
        drawer.style.display = 'block';
        if (icon) icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-xmark';
      }
    }

    function copyAccount(text, btn) {
      if (navigator.clipboard) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function() {
          if (btn) {
            var origHtml = btn.innerHTML;
            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-check" style="color: #10B981;"></i> <span style="color: #10B981;">Tersalin!</span>';
            btn.style.borderColor = '#10B981';
            setTimeout(function() {
              btn.innerHTML = origHtml;
              btn.style.borderColor = '';
            }, 2000);
          }
        }).catch(function() {
          copyText(text);
        });
      } else {
        copyText(text);
      }
    }

    function copyText(text) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      alert('Nomor rekening ' + text + ' berhasil disalin!');
    }

    // Hitung saat pertama kali load
    calculateZakat();
  
    function scrollToTop() {
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    // LISTENER SCROLL UNTUK TOMBOL BACK TO TOP (TRANSPARANSI SESUAI TINGKAT SCROLL)
    window.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
      var btnTop = document.getElementById('mobileBackToTop');
      if (!btnTop) return;
      var scrollY = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
      if (scrollY > 180) {
        btnTop.style.display = 'flex';
        // Semakin ke bawah transparansi menyesuaikan (0.65 hingga 0.9)
        var opacity = Math.min(0.9, 0.6 + (scrollY / 2000));
        btnTop.style.opacity = opacity;
      } else {
        btnTop.style.opacity = '0';
        btnTop.style.display = 'none';
      }
    });

  </script>
